CustomField.description: Created as part of the Auto Lead Assignment project at request of Alex R. Allows users to stop the auto-assignment from happening if manually creating Leads. This field is referenced in the "Lead Processes" process in Process Builder.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use only when Lead is created. Check this box if you would like ignore auto-assigning this Lead based on the Country.
CustomField.label: Ignore Auto-Lead Assignment
